name: Love Games & Love Signs
source:
Love Games & Love Signs is an 18+ gay romantic visual novel where you, the player, navigate both the best parts of college and the D&D campaign you never got to have.  

As one of the newest members of your school's TTRPG club, you'll take the chance to meaningfully bond with the others, both in and outside of the game. You've chosen to upend your stale life and your risk will pay dividends. They're hot, single, and ready to share their personal traumas with you.

What could be sweeter than gaming with your buds, unless you were dating one of them too?

[From [url=https://ragmaan.itch.io/lovegames]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Love Games & Love Signs是一款18岁以上的同性恋浪漫视觉小说，玩家可以在其中体验大学中最好的部分以及你从未经历过的D&D战役。

作为学校TTRPG俱乐部的最新成员之一，你将有机会与游戏内外的其他人建立有意义的联系。你选择颠覆你单调的生活，你的冒险将会带来回报。他们很性感，单身，并准备与你分享他们的个人创伤。

还有什么比和你的好友一起玩游戏更甜蜜的事，除非你也在和他们中的一个约会呢？

[来自[url=https://ragmaan.itch.io/lovegames]Itch.io[/url]]
